Ivy Tran: Thanks for joining today’s all-hands. Starting a quick follow-up thread for the Q&A we didn’t finish live. Owners, please ack and drop a short ETA.

Noah R: Ack. I'll investigate the autoscaling burst behavior question. Need to confirm: does Dedicated burst consume reserved capacity first or fall back to on-demand? Filing INF-4412.

Zoe P: I'll take billing clarifications: post-payments, will customers see burst usage on the same invoice line as committed capacity or separate? Tagging Finance.

Sam W: For public-facing wording, we should say "scales with reserved + burst capacity" and keep detailed billing mapping in contracts. Sam will draft one-liner for docs.

Finance Bot: Note: Current billing system creates separate line items for burst usage; team is evaluating aggregated view. Filing FIN-212.

Noah R: Update: INF-4412 created, will confirm runtime behavior and fallback order by Tue EOD. Also adding a note to the runbook about rate-limiter impact.

Zoe P: I'll sync with Finance and post a short FAQ blurb by Wed. Also adding an example invoice snippet (anonymized).

eng-bot: Recording + slides uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/all-hands/sep-2026  Recording: https://redwood.zoom.us/rec/share/uvwx1234 (internal access)

Sam W: Quick decision: public docs get the high-level line; contracts append numerical billing mapping. Sam will post PR for doc copy by Mon.

Ivy Tran: Action summary: Noah -> INF-4412 autoscale behavior (Tue); Zoe -> billing FAQ + invoice example (Wed); Sam -> public doc copy PR (Mon). Please react with :white_check_mark: when you’re done. I’ll close this in 72h if no further asks.
